primaryChecks.text: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
primaryChecks.previousContext: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.
primaryChecks.nextContext: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 本文は対象名「Ain」を明記する。採用は地名用例に限り、正確な現代位置の確定を含まない。
